name: dapp_pump_surf_extension
summary: Additive surface bolted onto the existing dapp_server: hosts the pump.fun bot-vs-human radar. The /dapp/pump_surf page embeds the Godot pump_surf scene and runs an HTMX poll every 2s to /dapp/api/pump_wave for a live WaveFrame. The wave endpoint reads the latest JSONL events file from ~/.cc/pump_stream/ (sibling agent A's ingest), loads ~/.cc/pump_surf_gate_decisions.json (sibling agents B+C+D's gate output) when present, and calls pump_visualizer_3d.build_wave_frame(events, gates, window_seconds=60) (sibling agent F's visualizer). When any of those modules / files are absent, the endpoint returns a fixed-shape stub WaveFrame (HTTP 200) so the radar + Godot iframe never break. Parent dapp_server.active.json, dapp_play_extension.active.json, dapp_morph_extension.active.json are NOT modified.
engine_pattern: Reuses dapp_server's stdlib http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer + string.Template render path. Adds module-level helpers (_stub_wave_frame, _latest_pump_events_path, _load_pump_events, _load_pump_gate_decisions, _build_pump_wave). Lazy-imports pump_stream_ingest.replay_jsonl when available; otherwise reads the latest .jsonl directly. Lazy-imports pump_visualizer_3d.build_wave_frame and stubs on ImportError. The /dapp/pump_surf page mirrors play_embed.html with a surf_state LED badge, wave-data metrics panel, manual surf form, and inline <style id='pump-style'> driven by hx-on::after-request='updateSurfStyle(event)'. HTMX configRequest hook injects 'Authorization: Bearer <localStorage.mspc_freetier_token>' on every poll.

added_routes.GET /dapp/pump_surf: PUBLIC · renders pump_surf.html — embeds /studio/godot/builds/web_instant_games/index.html?scene=pump_surf and runs an HTMX every-2s poll to /dapp/api/pump_wave to drive the surf-state LED badge + wave-metrics panel. The page itself renders without a bearer; only the polling endpoint is gated. godot_build_present flag stamped in the page so the template can show a fallback hint if the HTML5 export is missing.
added_routes.GET /dapp/api/pump_wave: BEARER · returns the latest WaveFrame JSON. Reads the most-recent .jsonl events file from ~/.cc/pump_stream/ (by mtime), loads ~/.cc/pump_surf_gate_decisions.json if present, and calls pump_visualizer_3d.build_wave_frame(events, gates, window_seconds=60) when importable. On ImportError or any failure: returns a fixed-shape stub {surf_state:'no_signal', bot_density_avg:0, human_inflow_score:0, ripples:[], crystal:'', stub:true} with HTTP 200 so the radar keeps polling cleanly. Inline crystal-anchor via inference_logger at tier='pump_wave_served', model='dapp_pump_route', scope='wave_get'.

added_templates.studio/dapp/templates/pump_surf.html: ~155 lines — surf-state LED badge (red/gold/green via --pump-surf-state-color), wave-metrics grid (bot_density_avg + human_inflow_score), Godot iframe at /studio/godot/builds/web_instant_games/index.html?scene=pump_surf, manual <form> calling /dapp/api/pump_surf_action with consider_buy (graceful 404 → focuses Godot iframe), collapsible <details> showing raw WaveFrame JSON, and a 'DRY-RUN by default — no real trades without SOLANA_NETWORK=mainnet-beta + PUMP_SURF_LIVE_TRADING=1' footer warning. HTMX hx-trigger='load, every 2s' with htmx:configRequest stamping Bearer <localStorage.mspc_freetier_token>. After-request callback updateSurfStyle(event) parses the WaveFrame, rewrites :root { --pump-surf-state-color: … }, updates the badge text, fills the wave-data panel, and refreshes the raw-JSON pre block.

added_helpers: _stub_wave_frame() — fixed-shape WaveFrame dict ({surf_state:'no_signal', bot_density_avg:0, human_inflow_score:0, ripples:[], crystal:'', stub:true}) served on import or build failure; mirrors the future pump_visualizer_3d.build_wave_frame output shape
_latest_pump_events_path() — returns most-recent .jsonl in ~/.cc/pump_stream/ (by mtime) or None; never raises
_load_pump_events(window_seconds=60) — prefers pump_stream_ingest.replay_jsonl when present; falls back to direct JSONL read; never raises; returns []
_load_pump_gate_decisions() — reads ~/.cc/pump_surf_gate_decisions.json when present; returns {} on absence or parse failure; never raises

_build_pump_wave(claims) — orchestrates events + gates + lazy import of pump_visualizer_3d.build_wave_frame; returns asdict(WaveFrame) or stub; inline crystal-anchor via inference_logger at tier='pump_wave_served', model='dapp_pump_route', scope='wave_get'; never raises
nav_changes: Added one pump_surf entry to nav.tabs in studio/dapp/templates/base.html, placed immediately after the existing /dapp/play_morph link added by the dapp_morph_extension sidecar — single-line addition, no other base.html edits.
boot_banner_addition: main() boot stderr banner gets one extra line: '/dapp/pump_surf /dapp/api/pump_wave' so operators see the new surface at startup.
substrate: additive — no own DB. Reuses freetier_gate.require_token for bearer gating, inference_logger for crystal anchors, lazy-imports pump_stream_ingest (parallel agent A) and pump_visualizer_3d (parallel agent F) when present, and reads ~/.cc/pump_surf_gate_decisions.json (parallel agents B+C+D output) when present.

runtime_state_files.~/.cc/pump_stream/*.jsonl: input — sibling agent A's pump_stream_ingest writes events here; the wave endpoint reads the latest by mtime
runtime_state_files.~/.cc/pump_surf_gate_decisions.json: input — sibling agents B+C+D's gate output; optional; absent → empty dict passed to build_wave_frame

inbound_callers: browser: visitors to /dapp/pump_surf (public page, no token required to view)
the in-page HTMX panel: hx-get /dapp/api/pump_wave every 2s with Bearer header stamped from localStorage.mspc_freetier_token
Godot HTML5 build: iframe loads index.html?scene=pump_surf and selects the pump_surf.tscn scene on its end (sibling agent G build)
outbound_calls: core/lib/pump_stream_ingest.replay_jsonl(latest_path) → List[event_dict] — lazy import, agent A build
core/lib/pump_visualizer_3d.build_wave_frame(events, gates, window_seconds=60) → WaveFrame — lazy import, agent F build
routing_connections.substrate_writes: crystal chain entries via inference_logger only — no trades fire from this surface

graceful_degradations: pump_visualizer_3d missing → /dapp/api/pump_wave returns stub WaveFrame (HTTP 200, stub:true)
pump_stream_ingest missing → /dapp/api/pump_wave falls back to direct JSONL read of the latest mtime file
~/.cc/pump_stream/ empty or missing → events=[], WaveFrame built over no events (or stub if build_wave_frame absent)
Godot HTML5 build not exported → iframe shows 404 inside the panel; the surf radar + form remain functional; godot_build_present='no' stamped in template footer
No bearer in localStorage → HTMX poll → 401 (unauthed inner panel rendered into #wave-data); page itself remains visible
build_wave_frame raises → stub WaveFrame (HTTP 200, stub:true) + stderr warning
inference_logger missing → crystal log skipped, response unaffected
guarantees: Existing dapp_server routes (services, mint, wallet, products, balance, buy, mint, healthz) are NOT modified
dapp_server.active.json, dapp_play_extension.active.json, dapp_morph_extension.active.json are NOT modified — additions live in this sidecar card only
/dapp/api/pump_wave is bearer-gated via the same freetier_gate.require_token path as the other write endpoints
Stub WaveFrame returned on import/build failure carries HTTP 200 so the Godot iframe and radar panel never break on a freshly-provisioned host

No real trades fire from this surface — the manual surf form is a UI that POSTs to a separate endpoint (/dapp/api/pump_surf_action) which is NOT exposed by this dApp; the executor lives elsewhere and is dry-run-by-default per pump_executor's own env gating
Stdlib-only — no new deps; all CSS / JS is inline in pump_surf.html
Single line added to base.html nav; no other template touched

smoke_test_2026_05_28.pump_wave_authed: ok — GET /dapp/api/pump_wave with valid bearer → 200 + WaveFrame JSON (stub-shaped while pump_visualizer_3d absent)

phase: pump.fun bot-vs-human radar surface. Pairs with parallel agent A (pump_stream_ingest), agents B+C+D (gate decisions writer), agent F (pump_visualizer_3d.build_wave_frame), and agent G (Godot pump_surf.tscn variant). The dApp side is forward-compatible: stub WaveFrame today, real radar the moment the modules + events land.
